title: Client Detail
description: Schema for content/data/clients/<slug>.yml — private fields are encrypted at rest.

name.description: Display name of the client company or individual

summary.description: Optional one-line context (acquisition, pivot, shutdown, etc.)

business_ids.description: Registered business identifiers (ABN, GST, PAN, CIN, EIN, UEN)

directors.description: Director or owner names from company registry

point_of_contact.description: Your direct contact at this client

total_billed.description: Total amount billed, with currency (e.g. '$5,000 USD' or '₹1,50,000 INR')

total_received_inr.description: Net INR received across all projects for this client, after fees and conversion
